prompt: During the public lecture on Mars, a man stands up and (says) that humans already live there in secret bases. The speaker does not get angry and decides to (talk) to him calmly after the slide. She (tells) the audience that no astronaut has ever visited the red planet yet.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется say that без прямого дополнения лица; во втором — talk/speak to для спокойного разговора с человеком; в третьем — tell + дополнение (the audience).

prompt: Minutes before the robotics final, their machine drops a plastic cup during a test run. Leo refuses to (talk) about whose fault it is while the judges are watching. Maya (tells) him to check the power cable instead of arguing. When the main battery shows zero percent, neither of them (says) a word.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глагол talk/speak about обозначает обсуждение темы; во втором используется конструкция tell someone to do something; в третьем — устойчивое выражение not say a word.

prompt: Claire arrives at the hospital reception with fresh flowers for her sister, yet she cannot remember the ward number. She asks if she may (speak) to someone at the desk for help. The nurse checks the screen and (tells) her to take the lift to the fourth floor. Claire (says) thank you and hurries down the hall.
explanation_ru: Speak/talk to используется для обращения к сотруднику; tell someone to do something передает указание; say thank you — устойчивое сочетание.

prompt: The evening stretching class is completely silent until a beginner's phone blasts a loud cartoon ringtone. His face turns bright red as he stands up to (say) sorry to everyone in the studio. The instructor smiles and (tells) him not to worry about it. Afterwards, he (speaks) quietly to the teacher about turning off notifications.
explanation_ru: В первом случае используется устойчивое выражение say sorry; во втором — конструкция tell someone not to do something; в третьем — speak/talk to с наречием образа действия.

prompt: Ten minutes before the algebra exam, Toby walks into the clinic claiming he has a terrible stomachache. The school nurse looks at his schedule and (tells) him the truth right away. She (says) that a sudden pain right before math is very common. Then she (talks) with him for a moment before sending him back to class.
explanation_ru: Tell the truth — устойчивое словосочетание; say that вводит придаточное без дополнения адресата; talk/speak with описывает беседу.

prompt: Just as the ticket inspector reaches his seat, Sam's phone battery dies completely. He quickly (tells) the inspector that he bought a monthly pass online this morning. The conductor (says) he needs to see a valid code or issue a fine. Sam asks to (speak) with the station manager at the next stop.
explanation_ru: Tell используется перед прямым дополнением лица (the inspector); say вводит косвенную речь без указания слушателя; speak/talk with употребляется для официального разговора.

prompt: Over morning coffee, Ben reads out a hilarious one-star review left by a guest who complained that their cat stared too hard. He (tells) his flatmate the whole story while trying not to laugh. They (talk) over how to write a polite public response. Ben (says) that thanking the guest for the feedback is the safest choice.
explanation_ru: Tell a story — устойчивое сочетание; talk over означает обсудить вопрос; say that вводит мнение без дополнения лица.

prompt: After a large oil painting vanishes from the gallery lobby, a detective knocks on doors across the street. An elderly neighbor agrees to (speak) with him about what she saw around midnight. She (tells) the officer that a tall man walked out carrying a frame and a bright red umbrella. She (says) she would recognize that umbrella anywhere.
explanation_ru: Speak/talk with используется для беседы со следователем; tell принимает прямое дополнение (the officer); say вводит высказывание без дополнения адресата.

prompt: While the schoolboys crowd around a Roman marble bust taking photos, the museum guide steps closer. She (tells) them how ancient statues often lost their noses during earthquakes or transport. One boy asks if they can (talk) about how restorers repair the stone today. The guide (says) that modern curators usually leave original damage untouched.
explanation_ru: Tell требует дополнения адресата (them); talk/speak about обозначает тему обсуждения; say that вводит факт без указания слушателя.

prompt: In the university archive, Nora studies a faded nineteenth-century map covered in curly notes. Because she does not (speak) French well enough to read old handwriting, she asks the archivist for help. The specialist (tells) her what the Latin and French labels mean. Nora (says) that the notes completely change her research.
explanation_ru: Для владения иностранным языком используется speak (speak French); tell употребляется с дополнением лица (her); say that вводит высказывание без дополнения лица.

prompt: Sitting by the harbor wall, the old fisherman shares memories of the village during the war. He (tells) the visitors a story about his grandfather hiding clay pots in a cave behind the church. When someone asks if the jars are still there, he (says) that nobody has checked since the 1950s. They (talk) for an hour as the boats come in.
explanation_ru: Tell a story — устойчивое сочетание; say that вводит ответ без прямого дополнения лица; talk/speak описывает продолжительную беседу.

prompt: Local archaeologists recently discovered that a heavy stone holding open a barn door was actually a carved medieval marker. The farmer (says) sorry for using the artifact as a doorstop for forty years. He (tells) reporters that he always thought it was just an ordinary rock from the field. Museum staff (speak) warmly about his decision to donate it.
explanation_ru: Say sorry — устойчивое выражение извинения; tell используется перед дополнением адресата (reporters); speak/talk about описывает отзыв о поступке.

prompt: While her husband naps peacefully on the living room sofa, Elena sits at the kitchen table with her nephew. She (tells) him how to fold a square sheet of paper into a neat little boat. Because they do not want to wake anyone, they (speak) in whispers. When the boat floats in a bowl of water, the boy (says) it looks like a real ship.
explanation_ru: Tell someone how to do something передает инструкцию; speak/talk in whispers описывает манеру речи; say вводит реплику без дополнения лица.

prompt: At the hardware store counter, David pulls a yellow sticky note out of his jacket pocket. He (says) the exact paint shade name his wife wrote down before he left the house. The clerk nods and (tells) him which aisle carries that matte finish. David (speaks) briefly with the clerk about how many liters he needs for two coats.
explanation_ru: Say используется для произнесения конкретного названия; tell требует прямого дополнения лица (him); speak/talk with about обозначает обсуждение деталей.

prompt: Before joining her afternoon video call with overseas clients, Hannah steps into the hallway. She (tells) her roommate to keep his voice down for the next hour. She explains that she has to (speak) with three team leads on camera. He (says) he will wear headphones and stay in the kitchen.
explanation_ru: Tell someone to do something выражает просьбу или указание; speak/talk with используется для делового общения; say вводит ответ без дополнения лица.

prompt: During the wedding dinner, the groom's best friend taps his glass and stands up. He (tells) a funny joke about how the couple met while arguing over the last washing machine at a laundromat. Everyone laughs and claps when he (says) their love survived even lost socks. Afterward, the bride walks over and (speaks) to him warmly about the speech.
explanation_ru: Tell a joke — устойчивое сочетание; say вводит косвенную речь без дополнения лица; speak/talk to используется для личного обращения после тоста.

prompt: At the family birthday party, Marco notices his visiting friend humming along without knowing the words. Since his friend does not (speak) Italian, Marco writes the verse down on a napkin. He (tells) him what each line means in simple English. His friend (says) the lyrics are much sweeter than the English version.
explanation_ru: Для владения языком используется speak (speak Italian); tell требует дополнения лица (him); say вводит оценку без указания слушателя.

prompt: When Maya reaches the top of the sunny hill, her friends are already waiting by the picnic blanket. She (says) thank you to everyone for carrying a giant watermelon all the way up the trail. They (talk) and laugh while slicing the cold fruit into thick wedges. Her brother (tells) her that planning the surprise hike was his idea.
explanation_ru: Say thank you — устойчивое сочетание; talk/speak описывает непринужденное общение; tell употребляется перед дополнением адресата (her).

prompt: While steaming milk for a latte, the barista leaned over the counter and ___ me that the old cinema across the street is turning into an indoor climbing gym.
explanation_ru: После глагола стоит прямое дополнение лица (me) и придаточное с that, поэтому нужен глагол told (said требует предлога to, а spoke/talked не вводят придаточное таким образом).

prompt: After accidentally splashing muddy puddle water onto a pedestrian's clean trousers, the cyclist stopped right away to ___ sorry.
explanation_ru: В английском языке используется устойчивое сочетание say sorry («извиниться»).

prompt: Because the visiting chef was still learning the local language, the olive oil producer ___ in simple English to explain why this year's harvest cost more.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения языка общения (in simple English) используется глагол speak (spoke).

prompt: When the beekeeper handed over a warm jar of wildflower honey, the neighbor ___ thank you and asked whether the hives had survived the storm.
explanation_ru: Say thank you — устойчивое выражение благодарности, в котором используется только глагол say.

prompt: As thick fog rolled down into the valley, the park ranger said the tourist to turn back before dark.
answer: As thick fog rolled down into the valley, the park ranger told the tourist to turn back before dark.
accepted_answers: As thick fog rolled down into the valley, the park ranger told the tourist to turn back before dark.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется в конструкции «глагол + дополнение + to-инфинитив»; для передачи указания или предупреждения нужно told someone to do something.

prompt: While waiting under a wooden shelter during a sudden downpour, the guide told why tropical storms usually stop quickly.
answer: While waiting under a wooden shelter during a sudden downpour, the guide said why tropical storms usually stop quickly.
accepted_answers: While waiting under a wooden shelter during a sudden downpour, the guide said why tropical storms usually stop quickly.
While waiting under a wooden shelter during a sudden downpour, the guide explained why tropical storms usually stop quickly.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell обязательно должно стоять дополнение, обозначающее слушателя (например, told us); без адресата используется said.

prompt: On the morning radio show, the weather presenter told sorry to listeners for yesterday's sunny forecast after everyone got caught in hail.
answer: On the morning radio show, the weather presenter said sorry to listeners for yesterday's sunny forecast after everyone got caught in hail.
accepted_answers: On the morning radio show, the weather presenter said sorry to listeners for yesterday's sunny forecast after everyone got caught in hail.
explanation_ru: Слово sorry сочетается только с глаголом say (say sorry), а не с tell.

prompt: A small wooden sign near the duck pond says visitors not to walk on the wet grass after heavy rain.
answer: A small wooden sign near the duck pond tells visitors not to walk on the wet grass after heavy rain.
accepted_answers: A small wooden sign near the duck pond tells visitors not to walk on the wet grass after heavy rain.
explanation_ru: Для запрета или просьбы с дополнением лица и инфинитивом (visitors not to walk) используется глагол tell, а не say.
